name: Tana
tagline: Agentic meeting platform where AI agents do the work during the call.
description: Tana is a meeting workspace with native video calling, real-time transcription, and AI agents that act during the call — generating artifacts like PRs, tickets, and storyboards rather than only summarizing afterward. A persistent context graph remembers people, projects, and decisions across meetings, and AI changes go through a human-approval proposal step. It evolved from Tana's earlier supertag-based note app.
insight: Pivoted from its supertag knowledge-graph note app — which drew a 160K waitlist and $25M in 2025 — to an agentic meeting platform.
edge: Its agents act live during the meeting — drafting PRs, tickets and storyboards — instead of just summarizing after, over a persistent context graph.
cons: Pricing tiers shifting with the pivot

references.title: Tana snaps up $25M with its AI-powered knowledge graph for work
